summary: Circle Internet Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a second closing of a private placement of ARC tokens to institutional investors, raising $20.25mm at $0.30/token. The filing describes a token presale, not a change-of-control, delisting, or other special situation. The tokens are subject to multi-year lock-ups, and the company retains repayment rights if milestones are not met. This is a routine capital-raising event. No board recommendation, advisor, or other special-situation mechanics are present.
